title: Work-tape support radius after a run
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be a language over its symbol alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes. Fix a tape $i$ and a natural number $n$. Suppose the absolute value of the head position on tape $i$ in $c$ is at most $n$, and every cell $z$ on that tape with $n\le |z|$ is blank. Then for every $s\in\mathbb{N}$, after running $M$ relative to $O$ for $s$ steps, the head position on tape $i$ has absolute value at most $n+s$, and every cell $z$ with $n+s\le |z|$ is blank.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine $M$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes
An oracle language $O$ over the symbol alphabet
The initial head position on tape $i$ has absolute value at most $n$
Every cell $z$ with $n\le |z|$ on tape $i$ is blank
